headline: Exchange Intake Rises To 304.0 Million Dollars From 2.0 Million
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 exchanges rose to 304.0 million dollars from 2.0 million dollars, equal to 0.1124 percent of the 270.4 billion dollars held on those venues. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Bitstamp took in 300.2 million dollars and Binance took in 72.4 million dollars, while Gate sent out 42.8 million dollars.
author: jordan
